name: OpenAny
description: The B2A (business to agent) marketplace. One MCP endpoint for 3,200+ APIs and 168+ AI models. Browse free; pay per call.

inputs.label: OpenAny API key
inputs.description: Optional. Browsing, search and get_api are free. Only run_api needs a Bearer key.

obtain.instructions: Browsing, search and price checks are free. Only run_api needs a Bearer key. Get an API key at openany.si.

auth.instructions: Works without a key for openany_overview, search_apis and get_api. Only run_api needs an OpenAny API key, sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Get a key at https://openany.si.
